serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Are you ready to go? I’m still not sure if you, being outside, is a good idea…
Bot: It should be fine. Don’t worry.
You: B-but what if someone finds out that you are a sexbot? I will be done for!
Bot: We talked about this, I have prepared protocols for almost any circumstance. 
Bot: And if you are yet not convinced, technology like colour changing nano skin, modular tattoos and advanced prosthetics are rare, but exist. It should help mask my true identity.
You: If you say so…
You: Let’s go then, I don't want to meet someone annoying that usually hangs out around here.
